data.title: JOB Referral
data.description: Referrals can provide you with a direct line to the hiring manager, bypassing traditional application methods. It also help to reach out to friends, family, former colleagues, and alumni who may have connections at companies you're interested in. this makes your application more noticeable.

data.title: Freelance Interviews
data.description: A freelance interview is a meeting or conversation between a potential client and a freelancer to discuss a potential project or collaboration. Freelance interviews are often focused on specific projects, rather than long-term employment. Freelance interviews and preparing effectively, you can increase your chances of landing projects.
